elements.name: bus station yard in Addis Ababa
early morning soft gold light and long shadows
long single-file queue of many men and women
people wrapped in white cotton shawls
small ticket window in a low building far away
shorter young man with backpack seen from behind in foreground
young man in blue denim jacket seen from behind just ahead

wrong_setting: No bus station at all: a single figure stands against a blank, plain paper backdrop with no yard, building, buses or queue.
notes: Regenerate the frame: it shows one front-facing young woman in a white shawl on a blank background. It needs the bus-station yard with a long queue toward a distant ticket window and parked buses, plus both young men from the reference sheets seen from behind in the foreground, the backpack boy last in line and the denim-jacket boy just ahead of him.
